I promptly purchased it to give it a try. I use both standard and all natural beauty products. Various people have mentioned the 'bad smell' of this lotion. It is in fact no

reviews.t: Have been using it for years
reviews.x: I heard about this product from a famous plastic surgeon in Paris, France. He told a relative of mine that had just had surgery done on her face that this product was exactly what to use post surgery and thereafter. He lives and works in France but had found this particular product during one of his visits to the USA and said that it was amazing. He suggested to all his patients to use it even if they had not had surgery. It is thick but once you rub it in you do not feel the thickness and has n

I purchased 3 jars of the cream in 2019, and the cream was really free of perfume smell, and I was very happy.  Somehow the cream I purchased this year comes with a very strong perfume smell. The smell is even stronger than its original formula with fragrance.  I am disappointed.

The consistency and color of the cream is not the same as the first jar I ordered.  This may be due to this formulation having more units of vitamin E than the previous jar.  The cream is thicker and a little less “greasy”, so doesn’t go on as smoothly.  It still works well for me though - I just don’t feel quite as moisturized.  It works well for applying over top of night serums - I don’t feel it provides a good base for wearing under makeup in the mornings.

For years I have used Vitamin E cream for sunburn on the kids, it removes the heat and the hurt and helps the healing almost over night. must apply liberally and continue to apply to the area as it soaks in. I always look for the highest " 50,000 I.U" I.U I can find and 50,000 is good. This is very creamy and smells good
I been using the 42,000 I.U. For over 10yrs and i love it. Try this new formula and it smell badly. My daughter and husband both also complained. Going back to the 42,000 I.U.
It was the only cream recommended by my surgeon after reconstruction to minimize scarring.

reviews.t: Must have moisturizer for my face
reviews.x: I have tried numerous moisturizers, some with collagen and other "miracle" ingredients to make my face look younger and all they did was make my face burn and red. This is the only one that I have found to work with my face and I can say my face feels softer and I don't feel the dry face feel an hour later I would feel with other moisturizers.

[[VIDEOID:5408287e1483fdaac885b320a18e5f3b]] So far I love it! Nice, creamy consistency but not too thick. It has a pleasant, very light green tea scent, no chemical smell at all. Goes on a little thick but rubs in very sheer and soaks into the skin for great moisturization. Might upgrade my review over time after continued use. Definitely a great product. Ignore the old reviews about an awful smell. The company has changed the formula since then.

Not sure if it’s this cream I’ve used for well over 20 yrs but people are amazed at my age because of my skin. It could be genes because I still have a head of thick dark hair with minimal gray at 65 but this cream should get credit for my skin in part anyways because I’ve had lots of sun exposure and stress, health & life in general and nary a wrinkle.

reviews.t: Soothing for any skin condition; but not a cure
reviews.x: This was a good soothing cream for my skin infection. Not curative but at least gave relief for about 7-8 hours. Also noticed some strengthening of the skin in and around the eczema. Previously the surrounding skin used to look fragile and paper thin, now it looks thicker and more supple and springy. What this cream helps with is bringing relief to the surrounding healthy skin which gets affected by the scratching or stretching of the eczema skin. But if you are looking for a cure, this is not i

reviews.t: Absolutely Great Skin Care Product For My Face
reviews.x: Feels great on my skin and my face feels softer than ever.  I have used Colonial Dames 42,000 I.U Concentrated Age Defying Moisturizer on my face since I was 18 years old. I am now almost 68 years old and my face looks young and is relatively wrinkle free.  I get compliments all the time! This moisturizer has even more Vitamin E, is lighter and has fresh new fragrance that is refreshing. I use both religiously. I am never without my Colonial Dames! I have never found any other product that I lik

reviews.t: Like it a lot better than the original
reviews.x: This is just as creamy and moisturizing as the original, but without artificial colors, fragrance, or parabens. Not sure why so many people dislike the natural scent, to me it's a very light orange/citrus and I like it a lot better than the perfumey, artificial scent in the original. It comes from the tangerine, bitter orange, and orange fruit extracts in the ingredients. I'll be ordering this one from now on!

reviews.t: This moisturizer is a must for dry skin.
reviews.x: I love love this cream..I have been using colonial Dames vitamin E cream for decades and now they came out with this richer version.I absolutely love it.
This is better than any expensive moisturizer have been using it for over two years now

This cream is very moisturizing. I washed my hands with 70% alcohol and then a soap afterwards and my hands still didn’t feel dry. I am using it to mix with Mango Butter so that it lasts longer. However the biggest problem with this cream is what everyone is saying. It SMELLS. the smell is strong soft if like an old lady smell or the smell of cheap bar soap. I personally do not like the smell and will try to mix something coconutty or vanilla with my DIY moisturizer to get it to go away. Don’t l

After using the 28,000 iu for some time, I thought a stronger fragrance free version with good reviews could only be better. Unfortunately, I'm not a fan. It stings my face a bit (freshly washed, no toner/serum/ect), I was left with residue the next day, and ended up with bumps all over my face (mostly small, a few big on my forehead). Noticeable texture. Yuck. I repurchased the 28,000 iu, and it's finally started calming down after a week.

I've been using this Colonial dame (42,000 i.u) t for over 20years. I just started using the 50,000 i.u and I love it. BUT, the perfume added to this moisturizer is way TOO strong for me. It gives me a headache because I could smell it on my face. That's why it's only 4 stars because of the strong perfume, otherwise, this product is great!  Could you minimize the amount of perfume you add OR better yet, have one that is unscented. Thank you

before purchasing this i was using ZO oil control pads but was looking for something at a more affordable price point. came across the Neutralyze line upon my search and decided to give it a try because of the great reviews. I've been using it for 6 weeks and feel that the pads are working well. you can feel the exfoliation and i also feel that it's brightened my skin with no breakouts. I'll be purchasing again!

I've been using the other style of this moisturizer for very long time and then it became harder to find the store so I just recently purchased this one. It is super thick and it's very good for my extremely dry skin. It lasts all day. I'm so glad I'm able to find it now as I'm going to be super moisturized and probably look 20 years younger in 2 months.

I've been using this cream for many years.  My mother also used it and loved it as much as I do.  It is soothing to my skin and keeps my well moisturized.  I'm 84 years old and my mom was in her late 80s when she began using this cream.  It's extra thick and creamy and extremely good for aged, dry skin.

Been using Colonial Dames with Vit E for over 40 years. Absorbs quickly. Use on my elbows, hands, feet and especially on my lips. Carry a tub in my car. Keep one at my desk. And always always always on my bedside table. Keeps my skin healthy and supple.

I switch more the regular Colonial Dames Vitamin E Cream which I have used for 15yrs of more as a facial moisturizer everyday.  The texture is a little different but this does have a higher Vitamin E I.U. listing.

reviews.t: Best vitamil E cream I ever used
reviews.x: It keeps my skin hydrated and moisturized the whole day and I bought so many creams on Amazon over the years.  I will keep on ordering this cream. There is nothing like it in South Africa were I leave.
Been using for years and now the new scentless formula is better then ever. Don’t purchase  for fragrance purchase for affect. The best moisturizer around. No need to spend hundreds of dollars!!!

claims.text: Many reviewers are long-term, loyal users who have relied on this cream for years or decades.
Reviewers praise its moisturizing and skin-softening results, especially for dry or sensitive skin.
A common complaint is the new natural fragrance/scent, which some find strong or unpleasant.
Some reviewers note the new formulation's consistency and color differ from the original.
Several reviewers value it for healing and post-surgery/scar care, often on professional recommendation.
